name: What are the benefits of replacing old windows during an exterior renovation?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of replacing old windows during an exterior renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Replacing old windows offers multiple benefits that enhance both your home's aesthetics and functionality. New windows significantly improve energy efficiency by reducing heat transfer, leading to lower heating and cooling costs. They also provide better sound insulation, increased security, and improved curb appeal with modern styles and frames. Additionally, advancements in glass technology can protect your interior furnishings from UV damage and reduce condensation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replacing old windows improves energy efficiency, reduces utility costs, enhances sound insulation, boosts security, and updates curb appeal.
